displayOrder.name: 星图剧场
displayOrder.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality UI design with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing. ONE independent desktop primary screen, 1440 x 1024, no browser/device chrome, no collage, no numbered concept label. Direction name for your reasoning: 星图剧场.
Reference image 1 is the user's current Harness term page: use only its VibePolaris brand, warm paper palette and typography; its three-column file diagram has been REJECTED, do not copy that layout. Reference image 2 is their beloved homepage star constellation: preserve its airy astronomical character, crisp small lime four-point stars, asymmetry, large black typography and enormous negative space. This is an educational term page for Chinese Vibe Coders, not a dashboard. Build a radically more compelling MINIMAL Harness explanation, no decorative galaxy wallpaper, no blue-purple gradients, no glow clouds, no cards within cards, no wall of small captions.
Hard constraints: desktop only; warm ivory #F5F3E8, almost-black #171A15, forest green #35502B, small chartreuse #BDD32F accents. At most two fonts, clean sans serif, readable 16px body and 14px minimum secondary text. Chinese text sparse and precise. Current date 2026-09-06; do not display dates.
Layout: top 64px existing minimalist VibePolaris logo and nav “术语  选型指南  工具  关于”. Under top nav, a small “返回星图” link. Large left aligned heading “Harness” at x160 y145 and Chinese subtitle “让模型持续把任务做完” beneath, total heading region about 150px tall, no oversized marketing filler. The central hero occupies x150..1280 y310..840 as an OPEN CONSTELLATION directly on paper, not boxed. A single large dark word “模型” with a lime star sits centrally around x660 y520. Three nearby smaller named star nodes “读项目”, “改代码”, “检查结果” are arranged asymmetrically around it. Restrained fine routes show a purposeful tool execution cycle, one luminous short trail moving from 检查结果 back to 模型, with tiny amber state “对比度不足” placed ON the active return route. An open fine dotted enclosing orbit labeled “Harness” groups the runtime tools, distinct from the model, without turning into a giant literal orbital diagram. On far right inside the hero, one modest browser-content preview only, about 250x220px, shows a completed dark-mode notes page titled “我的笔记”, 2 simple text rows and moon toggle. This is the real visible task artifact, not a separate data dashboard. One crisp short task sentence above the constellation: “给这个页面加上深色模式”. Bottom of hero has one dominant forest green “运行一次” button and minimal replay icon; one short status sentence “检查没通过，带着问题再试一次。” The feedback return route must communicate retry, not just decoration. At bottom a single quiet divider and links “一句话理解” and “相关词条”; no extra explanatory cards, badges, metrics, dashboards, features, lists or sidebar. Airy, distinctive, sophisticated product design. Screenshot should depict one coherent paused mid-execution state, not multiple states in one image.

displayOrder.name: 任务画布
displayOrder.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic production-quality desktop UI with strong hierarchy, beautiful typography and purposeful generous spacing. ONE primary screen at 1440 x 1024, no browser/device outer frame, no collage, no concept number. Direction name for reasoning: 任务画布.
Reference 1 is the current VibePolaris Harness page, rejected for its tiny file diagram and captions. Preserve branding and palette ONLY, do not clone its file-to-model-to-file columns. Reference 2 is its existing homepage star constellation, loved by user. Retain a small distinctive lime star as wayfinding; the HOME remains a star map but this TERM PAGE can have its own very minimal editorial composition.
User: Chinese Vibe Coder learning Harness by seeing a task completed. Goal: visually demonstrate the runtime coordinating file edits, validation and retries around a model. Desktop only, extreme minimalism, no small redundant prose, no card grids, no dashboards, no feature inventory. Target 1440x1024. Palette ivory #F5F3E8, nearblack #171A15, forest green #35502B, tiny chartreuse #BDD32F. At most 2 fonts; 16px body, min14px supporting text. Date anchor2026-09-06 but NO dates.
Composition radically different from a constellation diagram: asymmetric editorial two-region layout. 64px existing VibePolaris logo/nav bar. Narrow left column x150..455, large 74px title “Harness”, subtle lime brand star, Chinese subtitle “智能体运行框架” and one sentence “给模型接上工具、检查和重试。” Generous blank space beneath. At x150 y580 a compact unboxed “运行任务” green primary button and small replay icon. At x150 y670 one quiet status “正在修复对比度” with a subtle amber marker, and below a simple 3-step vertical index “读项目 / 改代码 / 检查” with only 检查 active. No body paragraphs, no label multiplication.
The broad right-hand region x530..1280 y200..820 is dominated by ONE large artifact: a live website preview that fills the space, elegant paper-framed browser CONTENT with extremely light thin rule, no shadows, titled “我的笔记”. At top of this region outside preview put the concise task “给这个页面加上深色模式”. Inside preview a tasteful dark-mode notes page with near-black green background, quiet warm white headings, one tiny moon/sun theme control, sidebar of 3 note names and central readable article title “把想法写下来” with two lines, no invented extra controls. Demonstrate the active repaired state: one selected line in the note content has a very thin lime focus outline; a small anchored feedback callout “已修复文字对比度” points to that line. Below this preview, a SINGLE narrow unboxed code change row shows “text: #536047 → #E9EBDD” and a small checkmark. No model brain box, no file cards, no visual pipeline: the task RESULT is the protagonist. At bottom of page one thin horizontal baseline with small “Harness 把检查结果交回模型” on left and “第 2 次尝试” on right, and maybe a light replay icon, never stacked toolbars. A mature, calm, meticulous design with purposeful microinteraction implied by a highlight and tiny feedback tether. No paragraphs explaining the mock, no annotations outside the product, no repeated microcopy, no artificial 3D objects. ONE coherent execution state, not before-and-after duplicates.

displayOrder.name: 接入实验
displayOrder.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality UI design with clear hierarchy, strong typography, purposeful spacing. ONE independent desktop primary screen at 1440 x 1024. No browser chrome, device, collage, concept number, multiple screenshots. Direction name for reasoning: 接入实验.
Attached image1 is VibePolaris current Harness page: its file diagram, caption-heavy treatment and normal panel layout were rejected. Use only brand/logo/palette/typographic heritage. Image2 is its beloved spacious star-map homepage: preserve the small chartreuse four-point star as brand, airy open composition, bold near-black typography. Homepage stays a star map; this mock is ONE Harness term page.
Audience Chinese novice Vibe Coder; explain model vs Harness through an obvious reversible ON/OFF intervention, not a wall of explanations or ornament. Scope desktop only. Extreme minimalism. Warm ivory #F5F3E8, forest green #35502B, nearblack #171A15, lime #BDD32F sparingly. 16px body, min14px secondary, at most2 fonts. Current date2026-09-06 but no visible dates.
Layout is a wide, horizontally oriented interactive experiment with compact centered heading. Top64px original VibePolaris logo/nav, generous white margins. Centered y150 title “Harness” at64px, tiny lime star to its left, one concise definition at y235 “模型做判断，Harness 让执行继续。” Below at y295 a single large elegant on/off toggle labeled “接入 Harness” in the ON position, unmistakably the main interaction, with ample breathing room.
A large open unboxed horizontal workbench from x150 to1290 at y420..730: left task sentence “给页面加上深色模式” next to an elegant small document icon; center-left a small circular model symbol with caption “模型”; at center a visible modular runtime bridge, one long slim forest-green rail directly on paper, containing three compact functional symbols and labels “工具”, “检查”, “重试”. Fine broken-line ghost segment below the bridge hints at the disconnected path but NO duplicated complete diagram. The rail clearly connects model to task artifact and one short curved return branch from 检查 to 模型 conveys retry. The model remains visually distinct and is NOT inside the Harness. On the right a single240x230px dark notes-page preview, “我的笔记”, two realistic lines, moon toggle, warm clear type, no dashboard. It has a very small checkmark “已应用” aligned below. The whole stage is wider and shallower than a card, seamlessly sitting on the warm base surface.
Under the bridge only one centered short state “检查通过，停止执行。” At bottom y840 a refined 2-position text legend “只回答” and “执行并检查” tied to the on/off state, with ON emphasis but not extra pills; one unobtrusive “重播” secondary control near far right. No additional primary CTA competing with the large switch. User should understand switching ON changes code advice into applied verified work, but don't imply a different or smarter model. Negative constraints: no colored UI cards, no redundant headings, no tiny technical logs, no progress percentage, no feature list, no futuristic neon, no gradients, no 3D. Use professional hairline vector-style product controls and clear physical continuity in the bridge, not decorative spaceship or circuit-board illustration. ONE coherent on-state screenshot with generous margins.
